component_height: height of the component in inches
component_width: width of the component in inches
left_side_door: indicates whether there is a door on the stile's left side when viewed from the room
LD_hinging_right: indicates whether the left side of the stile serves as the hinge stile for the adjacent door, rather than the keep stile
LD_height: height of the door on the left side of the stile
LD_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the door on the left side of the stile
LD_swinging_out: indicates whether the door on the left side of the stile swings outward into the bathroom
right_side_door: indicates whether there is a door on the stile's right side when viewed from the room
RD_hinging_right: indicates whether the right side of the stile serves as the hinge stile for the adjacent door, rather than the keep stile
RD_height: height of the door on the right side of the stile
RD_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the door on the right side of the stile
RD_swinging_out: indicates whether the door on the right side of the stile swings outward into the bathroom
